summary: MapLibre style raster renderer for tiles, clips and camera shots
use_when: Use to render MapLibre styles into camera views or raster clips.
avoid_when: Avoid for interactive maps or temporal map animation; use MapLibre directly.

assessment.rationale: Node library and server render MapLibre styles into raster tiles, clips or camera images. MIT; runtime requires Node 24.12+ and sharp system dependencies. Remote style sources require trusted inputs because fetching can reach internal resources.
